## Notes

Soft-body vehicles as nodes (point masses) and beams (massless springs that do not resist bending or torsion); beamSpring, beamDamp, beamDeform, beamStrength; cross braces required for rigidity; stiff beams on light nodes vibrate or explode (6 kg vs 7 kg node example); typical values such as suspension spring 40000.
